review.reason: Backbone identity is defined by weights, architecture, and tokenizer artifacts, all pinned by matching shard SHAs; the swap changes only sampler infrastructure (Python/torch/transformers/vLLM, CUDA12.8 vs 13.0 kernels), which is not a treatment. Frozen P0-A pins model, prompts, decoding, seed, counts, shared-bank reuse, truth pipeline, and gates; the proposed stack is the author-published runtime family from Skill-SP requirements.txt. The forcing event was technical and pre-outcome with zero generations, so there is no outcome exposure, selective rerouting, or second backbone. For this distributional estimand, bit-identical reproduction across kernel stacks is not scientifically required. max_model_len=6144 is nontruncating for all frozen prompts plus the full 4096-token output budget.
